steelman: After the round-1 loop-back, the design closes its one real robustness gap: ADR-008 adds a transactional outbox per producing service plus idempotent order.create/capture retry, so the dual-write window from RT-2 is eliminated and the sync-orchestration choice (ADR-007) is now crash-safe, with the reservation TTL as a backstop. All S1 correctness invariants remain satisfied, contracts are complete and consumable, and the remaining items are tracked, owned, and non-blocking for the backend fan-out. The plan is safe to fan out to per-component work (S3 contracts, S4a backend), with frontend explicitly gated on UX maturity.
